#about: The EVA boarding suit, as a hull. Owned by sbs_utils (procedural/eva.py), shipped in its media pack. Strict JSON, not YAML: the engine parses ship data as HJSON. Keep the final newline - the engine rejects a file without one. artfileroot is the whole path into the sbs_utils media pack; the pack version is part of it. The entry is complete on purpose: a hull missing hull_port_sets or torpedostart has crashed the engine at load. Small exclusionradius and fast turn_rate are deliberate - see the LegendaryMissions history of lm_eva_ships.yaml.

#ship-list.name: EVA Suit
#ship-list.long_desc: A hard suit with thruster packs, flown by one crew member inside a ruin.
